entry.title: An access inside a call's arguments or result assignment stays refused: 9,539 leaves on 2,408 Unknown functions, 242 sole-blocked
entry.why: Card W43-INDIRECT-ACCESS-GENERAL admits only statements with no call (the typed scalar-access route is never consulted for a statement that carries one). Measured at its AFTER census (docs/reports/w43-indirect-access-general/residuals.txt, class call-argument): 9,539 leaves of the five access-refusal families in 2,408 Unknown functions, 242 of them blocked by that family alone. These are `f(p->x)`, `x = f(p->x)` and `p->f = g()`; the borrowed-actual, bound-read and member-address routes already admit narrow cases. Admitting one needs the call's own contract (and, for an uncontracted callee, the call leaf remains: the census-2 exchange proxy). DISCHARGE: a card that admits a typed scalar access in a Borrowed data argument or as a call result's scalar destination, with the call's existing obligations retained, and a measured re-pin; or a recorded decision that the class belongs to the call routes.

ground: Its discharge condition: "a card that admits a typed scalar access in a Borrowed data argument or as a call result's scalar destination, with the call's existing obligations retained, and a measured re-pin; or a recorded decision that the class belongs to the call routes". Card W44-INDIRECT-CALL-ARGUMENT-ACCESS admits typed reads (scalar values over typed scalar accesses, pointer reads through `T **` bases and pointer members, non-pointer sub-object addresses) at declared Borrowed positions and in declared variadic data tails of contracted calls, retaining every obligation of the call (the statement is classified again by the ordinary classifier) and adding the typed read's dereference obligation and a second obligation before it, with Lean parity in QCore.CallArgumentAccess and a measured re-pin on the combined tree (docs/reports/w44-indirect-call-argument-access/README.md). The uncontracted part is recorded as belonging to the call routes (W44-CALL-ARGUMENT-UNCONTRACTED); the call-result destination (`p->f = g()`) is re-registered, measured, as W44-CALL-RESULT-INDIRECT-DESTINATION; every other refused shape is re-registered narrower with its AFTER-census size.

entry.title: The classifier names an assignment's destination by the first suffix of its left-hand side that spells a place, so `recs[i].name = x_dup(s); x_free(name);` certifies Safe
entry.why: `direct_assignment_destination` in crates/qcore-c-gateway/src/legacy_c.rs tries `canonical_place` on every suffix of the left-hand side, so `result [ index ] . label = CALL ( … )` is named `label` and `recs [ i ] . name` is named `name`; the lexical gate checks the destination only through that name's spelling, so a call whose actuals read no memory is modeled as binding the unrelated local. Found by W44-INDIRECT-CALL-ARGUMENT-ACCESS when its first AFTER run admitted `result[index].label = flb_malloc(...)` in flb_input_chunk_get_direct_routes (11 false leaks); that card's probe now declines unless the named destination is the whole left-hand side, so it adds no such statement. The pre-existing hole is pinned by crates/qcore-c-gateway/tests/call_argument_access.rs `the_pre_existing_suffix_destination_hole_is_pinned` (a fixture that certifies Safe while releasing the wrong object: a fail-closed violation, hard invariant 1). Corpus reach at the base: unmeasured. DISCHARGE: a card that names a destination only from the whole left-hand side (refusing every other), measures the corpus leaves and verdicts that move, and re-pins the fixture to Unknown.

ground: Registered by this card on its own branch only (3cbf3a6c), never on main, so the combined tree removes nothing for it. Its discharge condition ("a card that names a destination only from the whole left-hand side (refusing every other), measures the corpus leaves and verdicts that move, and re-pins the fixture to Unknown") is met by card W44-ASSIGNMENT-DESTINATION-SUFFIX-PLACE on main (gateway constraint 5i, docs/reports/w44-assignment-destination-suffix-place/README.md); this card's fixture `the_pre_existing_suffix_destination_hole_is_pinned` is re-pinned to Unknown with [GATE, unknown_alias:name] at the merge, matching main's `a_member_store_no_longer_binds_the_same_named_local`.

entry.title: Eleven provisional leak leaves the call argument rule exposed are false by source reading (leak pin 271 -> 282)
entry.why: Admitting an acquiring call's actuals makes its result tracked; three pre-existing leak semantics then report objects that escape. (1) An unsanctioned out-slot store (`*out_buf = buf`) keeps the site owed: cio_memfs_content_copy, cio_utils_read_file, initialize_exemplars_from_metadata. (2) An object linked into a member whose owner is returned is reported leaked: cmt_histogram_buckets_create_size, _exponential_create, _linear_create. (3) Releases through uncontracted helpers (free_metrics, free_resource_attributes) do not discharge: rd_kafka_telemetry_encode_metrics (5 sites). Each mechanism is reproduced on a fixture with no call-argument access at the base tree (docs/reports/w44-indirect-call-argument-access/README.md section 5.4). Seven functions and three units move Unknown -> provisional Unsafe. Provisional Unsafe is not an upstream defect claim. DISCHARGE: W44-LEAK-PIN-AUDIT or a card modelling these escapes, withdrawing the leaves measurably; or a recorded decision.

ground: Registered by this card on its own branch only (3cbf3a6c), never on main, so the combined tree removes nothing for it. Its discharge condition ("W44-LEAK-PIN-AUDIT or a card modelling these escapes, withdrawing the leaves measurably") is met on the combined tree: W44-LEAK-PIN-AUDIT's refused hand-on rule (legacy_refused_operands.rs, QCore.RefusedHandOnCustody) withdraws all eleven. Measured at this card's combined-tree AFTER (merge 9c8b7809): cio_memfs_content_copy, cio_utils_read_file, initialize_exemplars_from_metadata, the three cmt_histogram_buckets_*_create and rd_kafka_telemetry_encode_metrics carry 0 leak leaves and stay Unknown, and every unit this card moved to provisional Unsafe on its base stays Unknown; the three mechanisms' fixtures in call_argument_access.rs are re-pinned to Unknown with no leak.
